sources.title: How to Play Grand Theft Auto VI in the Cloud and with Remote Play
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto VI supports XBOX Cloud Gaming , making it available to play even without a current-gen console. With XBOX Cloud Gaming, you can play by streaming it straight from the cloud to your XBOX One, or XBOX Series X|S if you’d like to save some hard drive space. Select Game Pass plans include a monthly allotment of up to 15 play hours, and you can buy more cloud playtime if you need it, giving you the opportunity to experience one of the biggest games of the year on the consoles you already own. The game uses XBOX Series S graphics settings when cloud-streamed with XBOX Cloud Gaming. You can also access Remote Play to enjoy Grand Theft Auto VI wherever you want to play , allowing you to stream gameplay directly from your XBOX Series X|S console to devices you already own, like your mobile phone, laptops, PCs, or even a handheld gaming PC like the XBOX ROG Ally. Here’s how to get these features up and running (a copy of Grand Theft Auto VI from the XBOX Store is required): To start your Cloud gaming session in Grand Theft Auto VI , you can use the controllers that are connected to your console following these steps: When possible, connecting a wired Ethernet cable is the best option for gaming quality. FYI, even wireless networks with high bandwidth can occasionally have a dip in audio and video quality. sources.title: Jason's stoic character in Grand Theft Auto 6 was inspired by Steve McQueen and research into Army veterans: 'These guys typically aren't running their mouths'
sources.text: Rockstar made a point of creating "authentic characters that didn't stray too far from reality." It's already clear that Grand Theft Auto 6 has a very different timbre than most other GTA games. While criminal hijinks and acerbic satire remain part of the experience, it's also much more interested in portraying characters and relationships in a more convincing, human fashion. One of the most striking examples of this is its depiction of co-protagonist Jason Duval, who, unlike the vast majority of GTA's main characters, is often notable for what he doesn't say rather than what he does. According to Rockstar's senior vice president of narrative Rupert Humphries, Jason's laconic nature was inspired by a personality type observed in both cinema and real-life. "When we decided we wanted to tell a story about a couple on the run, we looked at all the similar kinds of movies, and one of the ones that really stood out was [Sam] Peckinpah's The Getaway" Humphries explained in a statement given to Destructoid (via GamesRadar ). Steve McQueen was famous for pulling lines out of scripts and saying things with his presence alone. We wanted to see how close we could get to that with a game character, where so many of our protagonists have been the opposite." Humphries says this also "resonated" with research the studio was doing around Army veterans, particularly Army Rangers. In Grand Theft Auto 6 , Duval is a veteran of the game's equivalent military organisation called the Marauders. "These guys typically aren't running their mouths or reacting to something unless it's strictly necessary, while still being strong and still asserting themselves," Humphries explained. Establishing a more grounded character was not solely a directive for Jason. It was a goal of the writing more broadly. This is interesting considering Florida was picked as the setting for GTA 6 in-part due to the wild 'Florida Man' stories that circulate on the Internet from the state. "Researching the prolific and headline-grabbing criminal activity that had been taking place over decades in Florida was an obvious starting point," game writer Michael Wiafe pointed out. "From then on, it was about coming up with authentic characters that didn't stray too far from reality but also were not totally bound by it either," Wiafe continues. "The majority of our main characters are undeniably reprehensible on paper, full-blown criminals, but also decent human beings. Their moral makeup isn’t necessarily cut-and-dry, and we don’t attempt to make excuses for them. What's important is how they resonate, no matter where you're experiencing the game in the world." This is just one of the things that makes Rockstar's latest crime sim a marvel on pretty much all fronts . And while us PC gamers will have to wait an unspecified amount of time before it arrives on the platform, you can bet it going to be quite the experience when it does. sources.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 has a 'complex drug network' that tracks everything from where drugs come from to 'how they eventually reach the street-level buyer'
sources.text: "Having that structure in the background as something we consistently refer to helps everything feel more real." I've only dipped my toe into Grand Theft Auto 6 thus far, but I'm already impressed by the detail Rockstar has baked into its world. One thing I'm always curious about with games like this, however, is how much of that detail is on the surface versus what's actually happening under the hood. I'm still too early in the game to judge this for myself, but according to Rockstar, there is way more going on in terms of how NPCs behave than players will ever likely see. One striking example of this is how GTA 6 's gang compounds conduct their drug operations. In an interview with IGN , Rockstar's senior design director for its open world Steven Messinger explained that GTA 6 fully simulates drug distribution from top to bottom. "A big part of [the open world's design] was establishing deep backstories for almost everything, even if they were never meant to be fully explained to the player, and then really sticking to those backstories," Messinger pointed out. "For example, our gang compounds have a complex drug network we've fully mapped out: where the drugs come from, who brings them in and how, how they're distributed to each compound, what happens at each stop, and how they eventually reach the street-level buyer." Messinger notes that "players will only pick up bits and pieces of this". But representing this process wholesale means that, when players do notice it, it always feels authentic and believable. "Having that structure in the background as something we consistently refer to helps everything feel more real, like this big machine is always running even when players aren't there." While this may only be designed for players to notice passively, I'm now keen to follow this system and see just how consistently it holds up. But it's such commitment to representing its world that has led GTA 6 to receive near-universal praise from critics, and it probably didn't hurt when it earned $3.79 billion on launch day , either. 2026 games : All the upcoming games Best PC games : Our all-time favorites Free PC games : Freebie fest Best FPS games : Finest gunplay Best RPGs : Grand adventures Best co-op games : Better together Keep up to date with the most important stories and the best deals, as picked by the PC Gamer team. sources.title: Has Rockstar taken the "Grand Theft Auto" out of GTA 6? Or has it just gamified car-jacking properly for the first time?
sources.text: It's impossible to have a big game launch these days without some section of the internet, somewhere, finding grievances with the final product because it does not align with the expectations they had pre-release. The most recent upset comes in the form of Grand Theft Auto 6 's revised take on, well, grand theft auto. In case you're one of the few still unfamiliar, grand theft auto is more than the titular moniker for Rockstar's premier crime simulation series; it's actually a US legal term for the act of stealing or attempting to steal a motor vehicle. In most previous GTA entries, this was a central part of the core gameplay loop: accept a mission, nick a car, complete the mission, nick another car, getaway. It's an endemic part of the loop, and has become so popular and identifiable as such that even other games - Watch Dogs , Saint's Row, Cyberpunk 2077 , and so on - have emulated the mechanic. So it makes sense that the internet is in a bit of a spin about GTA 6's more mature and restrained take on its eponymous crime. A quick, no-frills getaway in a vehicle you've hijacked on the road isn't always the most effective option. A mindless crime spree on the streets of Leonida is not a simple thing to pull off, nor an easy thing to live down. In this game, actions have consequences, and an ill-timed or ill-judged car jacking can quickly and efficiently put an end to your criminal ambitions. That's not to say you cannot simply steal cars. Of course you can: the option to saunter up to an occupied vehicle and jack it from its registered owner is available to you from the very beginning of the game. But the citizens of Leonida aren't going to take your wanton act of foolishness lying down; many of the motorists in the county will fight back, pull a piece on you, or run you over mid-robbery attempt. Even if you are lucky to find one of the more pliant residents of the city, you might find something peculiar is happening in their car. I jacked a woman in the city over the weekend, and the cat she was ferrying from place to place decided to attack me, causing me to crash. I've heard other people say they've had muffled cries coming from the boot of the car where someone is transporting a hostage, or incidents where they've jacked the same person multiple times, leading to the poor car's owner to have a breakdown in the middle of the city. That cat event, the team here at Eurogamer has worked out, is an early game trigger - it seems stealing random cars early in the game will increase the chance of this encounter occurring. Rockstar's guiding hand is more visible here, then, in trying to teach you a lesson: don't steal cars. You're given your own - Jason's two-door coupé utility, a Vapid Creado - that I actually formed quite an emotional bond with in the opening 10-or-so hours of the game. 'Look after this car,' Rockstar insists, tutorialising you how to repair it, customise it, make it all pretty so it's in good condition when you go pick up Lucia for the first time. Shortly after the 10 hour marker, narrative events whisk you away elsewhere and you're given a 'slim jim', a long, thin tool that allows you to break into locked cars - something you could only do with a quick elbow jab before. The benefit here is two-fold; you can break into cars without setting off their alarms, and without breaking glass and lowering their resale value (something quite important in the earlier sections of the game). So, it takes you until Chapter 2 to start being able to more reliably and consistently break into vehicles. Good. And it'll take even longer to break into keyless vehicles. We're in 2026 after all, and it's heavily implied this is when GTA 6 is also set - it stands to reason that many cars run keyless fobs, and your old-school tools won't cut it if you want to break into a Zorruso, rather than an old Vapid truck. But then, even when you're well-armed and ready to start an illustrious new career as Vice City's most nefarious car thief, there's more to consider. Most modern cars also come with trackers: standard trackers simply prevent you modding cars you don't own (not an issue you'll face very often), but advanced trackers are more problematic. Boosting a car with an advanced tracker immediately alerts the cops to your location, and they close in on you fast . The only answer to this problem is flooring it, and outspeeding the signal ping the tracker is sending out: you need to drive fast and cleanly in order to stay mobile long enough for the tracker to deactivate, and this often incurs damage that makes selling these cars to fences a less viable option. You can't even sell cars with trackers installed at all to some fences until you're much, much further into the game. So, long story short, stealing cars is a faff in GTA 6. But I like that. I like that Rockstar has evolved the gameplay formula to more accurately reflect the state of the world in 2026. Modern problems require modern answers, and given that Rockstar has gone above and beyond in its creation of a sandbox simulation of Florida , I feel the immersion would be broken by just being able to saunter up to any car you want and break into it. No, needing a 'slim jim' or a key cloner - or needing to case my victims properly before trying to jack them - makes for a better game as far as I'm concerned. It makes me roleplay Jason and Lucia better, it makes me engage with the game's systems more, it makes me appreciate the cars that I do have whilst I have them. It also improves the flow of the game and how I interact with missions. I recently played GTA: Vice City , and after most missions were wrapped up, I would simply fling the nearest motorist onto the sidewalk, hop in their car, and drive away into the Malibu-styled sunset. I can't simply do that in GTA 6: I need to think about my getaway options, whether there's heat on my car, and where my next best (and cheapest) ride is going to be if a robbery or raid goes awry. sources.title: The Grand Theft Auto 6 hacker who was hospitalized in 2023 has been released on parole with a warning not to do it again
sources.text: Following his guilty plea, Arion Kurtaj was given a seven-year sentence but released "on license" with a warning and restrictions to his online activity.. A BBC report says Arion Kurtaj, the Grand Theft Auto 6 leaker who was given an indefinite sentence in hospital in 2023 because he kept hacking into things or expressing intent to, has been released with a stern warning not to do it again. Kurtaj was sentenced to seven years in prison, according to the report, but was released on license—similar to parole in North America—the same day, with his hospital stay and time in prison while awaiting retrial credited as time served. He was given a five-year "Serious Crime Prevention Order" restricting his allowable online activity, including bans on using Telegram and Discord. "Kurtaj knew what he was doing when he carried out these crimes and has finally admitted his involvement," Detective Inspector Mike O'Sullivan of the City of London Police said following Kurtaj's sentencing and release. "We hope this case serves as a lesson that these types of acts will not be tolerated. "Although cyber crime is borderless, we will seek to utilise the co-operation of partner agencies and international law enforcement to ensure that offenders are brought to justice no matter where they offend from." Kurtaj carried out hacks against multiple companies when he was 16 and 17 years old, including Microsoft , Samsung , Nvidia and UK telecom company BT&EE, and stole millions in cryptocurrency from individuals. But it was his hack of Rockstar and leak of GTA 6 materials more than a year before it was formally revealed, that earned him notoriety, not least because of how it was carried out: While under police protection in a Travelodge hotel room , using an Amazon Fire Stick and a mobile phone. A psychiatric assessment determined that Kurtaj had "acute autism," and that he "continued to express the intent to return to cybercrime as soon as possible" while he was in custody. That led to his hospital sentence , but earlier this year he was found fit to stand trial and subsequently pleaded guilty to all charges . That struck me as odd—why plead guilty to crimes carried out at a time when your mental state was such that a court decided you required multiple years of institutionalization?—but this may be the answer: Kurtaj, now 21, is a free man. The judge on the case told Kurtaj he is "a very talented young man," but also warned him: "Don't let this happen again." sources.title: Grand Theft Auto VI for PS5 tops 39 million players
sources.text: More than 39 million unique users have played Grand Theft Auto VI on PlayStation 5 as of November 22, making it the biggest launch in PlayStation history across three decades and five console generations, Sony Interactive Entertainment announced . The sequel set a new record for the highest number of concurrent players for any game on PlayStation, surpassing previous records across multiplayer, free-to-play, and single-player titles. Across PlayStation 5, players cumulatively logged 683 million hours of gameplay in Grand Theft Auto VI , and have spent an average of 17.4 hours exploring the game’s world during its opening days. Grand Theft Auto VI ‘s launch also marked the largest number of newly connected PlayStation 5 consoles on a single day since the console’s launch, outside of end-of-year holidays. Since launch, it was the first played game on 70 percent of new PlayStation 5 consoles. “We want to congratulate our partners at Rockstar Games for bringing this extraordinary game to players around the world and continuing a partnership with PlayStation that stretches back to Grand Theft Auto III on PlayStation 2 ,” Sony Interactive Entertainment content communications manager Tim Turi said. “With [ Grand Theft Auto VI ], we worked to bring the best experience on [PlayStation 5] and gave players a memorable way to commemorate the game with two special limited-edition DualSense wireless controllers inspired by Vice City. We also celebrated the launch with live events including Grand Theft Auto VI : The Festival in Miami this past weekend.” Grand Theft Auto VI launched for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series on November 19. On November 20, Rockstar Games announced that the game achieved $3.79 billion in day one retail sales following 32.5 million pre-sales. Although Rockstar Games did not share exact unit numbers, the revenue total suggests roughly 37.9 million to 47.3 million copies sold, based solely on pricing across its $79.99 and $99.99 editions.

sources.title: PS5 Games on Sale for $15 for Black Friday
sources.text: In the olden days (a few years ago) you had to wait until the actual day of Black Friday before the killer deals would crop up. Those days are officially gone. Today, on the Monday before Black Friday official, Walmart kicked off its “ Black Friday Event 2 ,” dropping some absolutely killer deals, and Amazon is price matching most of them. Among the discounts are a bunch of PS5 games on sale for just $15. These games are excellent and not that old. So grab what you want, because you’re not likely to find them cheaper any time soon. What games are we talking? For starters, Mafia: The Old Country, an excellent single-player game that came out last year that our reviewer called “an effective return to the linear and tightly story-driven format of the original Mafia and Mafia II.” Then there’s Assassin’s Creed Shadows , in which Ubisoft’s long-running series finally goes to Japan. We gave it an 8/10 in our review , saying, “By sharpening the edges of its existing systems, Assassin’s Creed Shadows creates one of the best versions of the open-world style it’s been honing for the last decade.” Then there’s Borderlands 4 and Star Wars Outlaws and WWE 2K26, all fine games worth checking out if you haven’t already. Fifteen bucks will even get you Elden Ring, Fromsoft’s sprawling, open-world masterpiece that we gave a 10/10 in our review when it came out in 2022. That same year, we awarded it Game of the Year . Other all-time low prices can be had now as well, like AirPods Pro 3 for $149 and Metal Gear Solid Master Collection Vol 2. for $29.99 . sources.title: Thank you for making Grand Theft Auto VI the biggest launch in PlayStation history
sources.text: Celebrating the PlayStation community and Rockstar Games for creating an incredible moment in gaming and entertainment. After a long wait, players finally have had the chance to jump into Grand Theft Auto VI . It’s been amazing to see the PlayStation community around the world begin their adventures in the state of Leonida. Whether you’ve been counting down the days to return to the streets of Vice City or you’re experiencing the Grand Theft Auto series for the very first time, we want to take a moment to say: thank you. The excitement and passion of the community have made this a truly special moment for all of us. The launch of GTAVI marks an extraordinary moment for gaming and entertainment, becoming the biggest game launch in PlayStation history, across three decades and five console generations. More than 39 million unique players have experienced Jason and Lucia’s story in Grand Theft Auto VI on PlayStation 5. The PlayStation community came together in a big way to experience Grand Theft Auto VI during its launch and opening weekend. Here are a few highlights from the launch window ending November 22, 2026*: These are just a few ways we’ve seen our PlayStation community come together around this incredible moment in gaming, and we’re excited to see how you continue to build and share new memories and experiences in the months ahead. Finally, we want to congratulate our partners at Rockstar Games for bringing this extraordinary game to players around the world and continuing a partnership with PlayStation that stretches back to Grand Theft Auto III on PlayStation 2. With GTAVI, we worked to bring the best experience on PS5 and gave players a memorable way to commemorate the game with two special limited-edition DualSense wireless controllers inspired by Vice City. We also celebrated the launch with live events including Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival in Miami this past weekend. And to our PlayStation community, thank you for your continued passion and support, and for choosing to experience GTAVI on PS5 . It’s your enthusiasm that make moments like these so meaningful for all of us. We can’t wait to see where your adventures in Leonida take you next! *All figures are based on SIE internal data collected from November 19, 2026, to November 22, 2026

sources.name: IGN
sources.title: GTA 6 Was Biggest Launch in PlayStation History
sources.text: Now that the dust has somewhat settled after the avalanche that was the launch of GTA 6, PlayStation has revealed some of its stats from the game, revealing that this was the single largest game release in PlayStation history. PlayStation’s November 23 blog post states that more than 39 million unique players have played the game on the PlayStation 5, setting a new record for the highest number of concurrent players for any PlayStation game. This beats out other records for multiplayer games, single-player games, and perhaps most astonishingly, even free-to-play titles. On top of that, GTA 6 players logged a total of 683 million hours played in the game, with the average player spending an estimated 17.4 hours sticking up virtual pawn shops and stealing NPC’s cars during its first few days. What’s more impressive is the sheer amount of people who purchased PS5s specifically to play GTA 6. PlayStation’s blog says it saw the “largest number of newly-connected PS5 consoles on a single day” since the console’s launch in November 2020, not counting end-of-year holidays like Christmas. Since GTA 6’s launch, it was the first game played on 70% of these new consoles. GTA 6 has, perhaps unsurprisingly, broken a slew of big records. The most prominent of these is its status as the biggest entertainment launch of all time, with Rockstar reporting that the game earned $3.79 billion in its first 24 hours. On top of this, internet provider Comcast said that GTA 6’s launch day was its highest-traffic day ever , with 24% of all its internet traffic during peak times coming from users downloading and playing Rockstar’s latest offering. Xbox had its own big records, too; Xfinity, which is under the Comcast umbrella, said GTA 6 increased the internet traffic on Xbox consoles by four times the normal amount this November. People are still making new discoveries in this game, and there’s bound to be many more that pop up over the next few months. GTA 6 is up for eight awards at The Game Awards and has enjoyed massive critical reception, with IGN scoring it a glowing 10 out of 10 — the title of ‘Masterpiece.’ Reviewer Luke Reilly praised the game for being “exquisitely detailed, endlessly ripe for experimentation, and uncompromisingly engineered,” saying “Grand Theft Auto 6 is the single most impressive video game I have ever played.” It’s unlikely that we see a game release as big as this one, with such a massive cultural impact, ever again. Rockstar certainly set a new standard for the industry with this one, to the point where many users aren’t sure if a photo they see online is from the real world or from the game . Just getting started in GTA 6 or wondering what to do next? Check out the Official Grand Theft Auto 6 guide right here on IGN. If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips and Chapter 2 Guide and Tips . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map . Virginia (she/her) is IGN’s News Editor. With ten years of experience reporting on games and entertainment, she’s got a storied background in the fighting game community, influencer news, and viral online trends. Find her on Twitter at @TheeMissGlaze .

sources.title: GTA 6 was the ‘biggest launch in PlayStation history’ with over 39 million players
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto 6 was “the biggest launch in PlayStation history,” according to Sony, with over 39 million users playing the game on PS5. According to a post on the PlayStation blog, players cumulatively logged 683 million hours of gameplay in GTA 6 between launch and November 22. The game also set a new record for concurrent players of a single game on PlayStation consoles. PlayStation also claims that the platform holder “saw the largest number of newly connected PS5 consoles on a single day since the consoleâs launch, outside of end-of-year holidays.” GTA 6 was also “the first game played on 70% of new PS5 consoles” during the period of launch until November 22. This comes after Rockstar and publisher Take-Two announced that Grand Theft Auto 6 has become the most successful launch for any piece of media in history, after being pre-ordered over 32 million times. On Friday, Rockstar and Take-Two claimed that the game has generated $3.79 billion in day one retail sales, “setting a new record for entertainment across any medium, and becoming the biggest entertainment launch in history.” For comparison, Spider-Man : Brand New Day generated $2.5 billion across its entire theatrical run as the highest grossing film of the year. When compared to other GTA titles, GTA 5 generated $815 million on launch day, which means GTA 6 managed almost 5 times as much. Grand Theft Auto 6 released on Thursday November 19, 13 years after the previous entry in the franchise. Upon release, the game achieved a record-tieing 99 out of 100 on Metacritic , making it one of the highest rated games of all time. VGC’s Grand Theft Auto 6 review calls it “the game of the generation”, saying Rockstar “delivers its modern masterpiece with a remarkable artistic achievement that exceeds all expectations”. sources.title: God of War Laufey's Faye actor jumps from games to live-action, as Amazon casts Deborah Ann Woll in upcoming series
sources.text: After appearing in both God of War Ragnarok and next year's God of War Laufey, Deborah Ann Woll is about to reprise her role as Faye in Amazon Prime Video's upcoming live-action series. Variety reports that the God of War cast list is now welcoming a second actor pulled straight from Sony Santa Monica's video game series. Deborah Ann Woll first showed up in the games as Kratos' wife and Atreus' mother during God of War Ragnarok, but she's also about to enter the spotlight proper in God of War Laufey. Amazon's God of War cast now includes Dave Bautista (Guardians of the Galaxy) as god killer Kratos, Callum Vinson (Chucky) as Atreus, Mandy Patinkin as Odin and Ólafur Darri Ólafsson as Thor. Alastair Duncan is also making the game-to-show jump by stepping back into the figurative shoes of chatty head Mimir. Earlier in the year, the God of War show halted production when former Kratos actor Ryan Hurst suffered an on-set injury. Bautista soon took over the role and production began again in October - all of Hurst's scenes had to be reshot, of course. There's no release date yet for the show, but it's said to follow the Norse era of the games which began in 2018's more serious and stern revamp. Amazon ordered a two-season run for the show, which apparently means both seasons will be filmed back-to-back. Meanwhile, God of War Laufey was recently delayed from February 2027 to May 2027, giving the PS5 exclusive slightly more breathing room away from Fable, Persona 4 Revival and Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis. "We will make the most of each moment until then by putting in the finishing touches and pushing the game to its fullest potential," developer Sony Santa Monica said at the time. "On behalf of everyone on the team, we appreciate your patience and we'll be back to share more updates soon." While the game puts Faye in the leading role as she battles with gods in a multi-mythological afterlife, the studio was quick to note that her journey isn't considered a side game. God of War Laufey will still connect to future games in the series and, yep, Kratos will eventually be back , too. "Genuinely, I thought I was going to be much more offended by it, but one, I'm not on social media, so that helps, and two, I don't know, I feel totally unbothered," Woll said of the online trolls who were targeting Laufey after its reveal this summer. "Because I just know it's great. It's okay if it's not your cup of tea, but in no universe is it bad."

sources.title: How to steal the Declasse Vamos in GTA 6
sources.text: Grab the code to unlock the garage and steal the car for Moses. The Declasse Vamos is one of the many cars Moses asks you to steal for him in GTA 6 , but like the BF Bandito , it's a little trickier than just grabbing it. When you reach the map marker, you'll realise the car is locked in a garage that requires a specific code to open it. The code to the door is 2727 and this is fixed. The way you discover this is by sneaking inside the trailer and looking at the number plate on the wall to the left of the window, just above the guy snoozing in the chair. Enter the code to open the garage, break in with the slimjim, then hit the button to open the door. I personally incapacitated all of the people behind the trailer, so chances are they will pursue you or start shooting if you don't, once you try to drive out of there. Now take the car back to Moses, being careful on the way, to earn $4,100ish for top condition. sources.text: Prove yourself to Raul by yoinking this car. sources.title: GTA 6 Crosstown Traffic walkthrough
sources.text: How to complete Crosstown Traffic in GTA 6 Here’s how to complete Crosstown Traffic in GTA 6. The mission, which is given by your new contact Raul, splits the couple across Vice City. While Jason follows a convoy of boats along the river on a motorbike, Lucia boards a metro overground train to get close to one of the gang’s associates. Here’s everything you need to know about completing Crosstown Traffic in GTA 6, including what rewards you’ll get at the end of it. Are you looking for more GTA 6 guides? Then check out our GTA 6 Guide Hub . Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to checkÂ out ourÂ complete walkthrough hub , featuringÂ beginner tips , navigation experience explained , GTA 6 cheats , and more. Once you’ve received the phonecall from Raul, you can start the mission from either of two locations: It doesn’t matter which character you choose . Both starting locations lead into the same mission, with the story switching between Lucia and Jason as the operation unfolds. This also doesn’t impact what rewards you get, or any choices in the mission. The mission is split into several objectives, alternating between Lucia’s metro operation and Jason’s pursuit of the boat convoy. The game swaps you between the two automatically, so you don’t need to keep an eye on this. After the opening cutscene, you’ll take control of Jason, who is riding a motorbike along the riverbank. Your objective is to follow the boats carrying the shipment. Stick to the dirt paths alongside the river and keep the boats in sight as you follow it through Vice City. If you let them get away, or destroy the bike by falling into the water, the mission will end. As long as you keep up with them, you’ll be fine. You can’t take them down here or anything like that, you’re just tailing them until the game automatically swaps to the next portion with Lucia. Eventually, Jason will reach the drop-off point and the game will switch to Lucia. Lucia’s part of the mission begins with her missing the train. You’ll need to catch up with it before it gets too far away. Sprint underneath the elevated railway tracks, following the route marked on your minimap. You can jump into a car (or in our case use one of the Lime scooter-style Escooters that are sitting around) to make it to the next metro station. If you miss the train’s departure, it may be possible to board it at the next station, but it’s also possible the mission will fail for you getting too far from the gang.Â Â Look for the stairs leading up to the next metro station. Once you reach the platform, board the train. It’s worth moving quickly during this section, as wasting time can make it harder to catch up with the train. Once aboard the metro, make your way towards the front carriage to find the Guardia Brothers member. Approach the man and intimidate him. Lucia will force him to the floor, allowing you to pressure him into cooperating. You’ll then need to take his phone and make him place a call to the boat couriers. Either of the conversation prompts works here, as he will eventually make the call. With the call made, Jason can move in on the shipment. The game automatically switches back to Jason, who finds himself under attack from gang members on the dock. Take out the two armed baddies before getting back on the motorcycle. Follow the boats along the river, keeping an eye out for Karim’s directions. When he tells you to turn right at the bridge, follow his instructions. Continue along the route until you reach a ramp that launches Jason onto one of the boats. This part is scripted so you just need to get into a good enough position that the game will throw you aboard. Once aboard, deal with the enemy crew.Â When you’re close enough, jump across to the boat carrying the shipment. With the boat under your control, the operation moves into its next part of the mission as Lucia. You’ll switch back to Lucia, who is still aboard the metro. At this point, more gang members will appear and attack her.Â Take them down using melee attacks. Once the enemies have been dealt with, make your way towards the back of the train.Look for the emergency Stop button and interact with it before the train reaches the next station. This completes Lucia’s part of the mission. The game now switches back to Jason. The final section of Crosstown Traffic sees Lucia join Jason aboard the stolen boat. You’ll now need to defend the shipment against waves of pursuing enemies, including gang members on jetskis, armed boats and eventually the Coast Guard. Before the firefight gets underway, check the rear seats of the boat. You’ll find an assault rifle and body armour that will make the upcoming battle considerably easier. You’ll have unlimited ammo in this section, so don’t worry about that, though you’ll still have to reload after every 30 bullets. Focus on the drivers of the pursuing boats and jetskis. Taking out the person controlling a vehicle will cause it to crash, making this a much more effective strategy than repeatedly shooting at the vehicles themselves. You can shoot the boats to disable them, but this takes way longer than a well-placed Focus Mode headshot. Eventually, a Coast Guard helicopter will join the pursuit. Rather than wasting ammunition firing at its body, aim through the front windshield and take out the pilot. Keep defending the boat until you get a scripted sequence with Karim droping containers from a bridge. This brings the playable part of Crosstown Traffic to an end. With the shipment secured, the mission concludes. That’s everything you need to know about Crosstown Traffic from GTA 6.

sources.title: GTA 6 Car Service walkthrough: How to steal the Schafter V12
sources.text: Wondering how to steal the Schafter V12 in GTA 6? In this GTA 6 Chapter 3 mission, Lucia steals a luxury car from a gang-run chop shop and delivers it to one of Raulâs contacts. This mission also introduces you to Randy, a new vehicle drop-off point. Here’s everything you need to know about completing Car Service in GTA 6, including how to find the Schafter V12, escape the police and earn your reward. Need even more GTA 6 guides for Chapter 3 of Grand Theft Auto 6 ? Then check out our GTA 6 Guide Hub . Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to checkÂ out ourÂ complete walkthrough hub , featuringÂ beginner tips , navigation experience explained , GTA 6 cheats , and more. In GTA 6, Car Service becomes available after completing the Meet the Heders mission . Once you’ve finished, wait approximately one in-game day for a message from Raul. You’ll then receive a new mission marker in Vice City, where Lucia is tasked with stealing a Benefactor Schafter V12 from a gang hideout. Before entering the chop shop, look for a nearby vehicle with equipment stored in its trunk. Inside, you’ll find a silenced Klose K17 pistol and flash grenades. The silenced pistol is perfect for this next section, as the chop shop is pretty open plan, and thus difficult to stealth through. Head towards the compound and look for a white van. Climb onto its roof to access the metal roofing surrounding the yard.Â From here, you can survey the area and keep an eye on the gang members guarding the entrance. Be careful around the dog near the gates, as attacking it unnecessarily can negatively affect your criminal profile. The car is parked underneath the covered section in the middle of the chop shop, next to a small room. If you want to verify it’s the correct car,Â you can scan it with the WAINK app. Head towards the vehicle, deal with any remaining guards and get behind the wheel. Drive out of the compound and escape the area. You don’t actually have to take out the guards, you can just leave with the car, but taking out the guards makes it much easier, and doesn’t risk destroying the car, which will fail the mission. Once you’ve escaped, follow the GPS route to Leonida Auto World, where Randy is waiting.Drive into the dealership’s parking area to trigger the final cutscene and complete the mission. The reward for completing Car Service earns you $3,000 and unlocks Randy as a vehicle drop-off point. He can purchase certain vehicles you bring him, including cars with standard trackers and vehicles on his request list.

sources.text: GTA 6 é bom? Confira a review do aguardado Grand Theft Auto VI Apenas alguns dias após a grande estreia, GTA 6 já recebeu uma nova atualização no PS5 e Xbox Series X|S que corrige problemas no sistema de salvamento automático — além de outros erros relatados pelos jogadores. O patch, que já está disponível para download, tem cerca de 603 MB e leva o jogo para a versão 01.002.002. Entre as mudanças, a Rockstar também corrigiu falhas que impediam a perda do nível de procurado e o acionamento correto de algumas ligações telefônicas. A atualização ainda resolve problemas de travamento e outros erros que afetavam diferentes atividades do jogo. Desde o lançamento de GTA 6 , os jogadores têm relatado dificuldades com o sistema de salvamento automático. Em alguns casos, os problemas teriam resultado até na perda de dados, fazendo com que parte do progresso nas primeiras horas de jogo desaparecesse. Embora o título salve automaticamente após missões principais e algumas atividades secundárias, o recurso aparentemente não estava funcionando de maneira consistente. Inclusive, houve relatos de jogadores que concluíram missões importantes, mas não tiveram o progresso registrado corretamente. A Rockstar afirma que corrigiu o problema na atualização mais recente, que também resolve outras falhas relacionadas à progressão. Entre elas, estavam erros que impediam o acionamento de ligações importantes para avançar na história ou desbloquear conteúdos de missões. Além de instalar o patch, vale conferir se o salvamento automático está funcionando normalmente. Por precaução, também é recomendável pausar o jogo e salvar o progresso manualmente sempre que possível. Confira as notas completas da atualização: Embora tenha sofrido review bomb da comunidade recentemente, GTA 6 é sem sombra de dúvidas o maior jogo de todos os tempos — não apenas pela sua escala monumental, mas também pelo impacto cultural que vem causando desde seu período de pré-lançamento. Mesmo gigante de diferentes formas possíveis, o game tem uma reprodução bastante assertiva nos consoles . Para aqueles que desejam a cobiçada platina do jogo, saibam que GTA 6 possui uma lista com mais de 50 troféus/conquistas para desbloquear . Além de um mapa interativo que pode te ajudar muito na jogatina, o título também conta com uma série de cheats e trapaças — mas que são ativáveis de forma diferente em comparação aos games anteriores da franquia. E você, já está jogando GTA 6 ? Conte nas redes sociais do VOXL se também enfrentou problemas com o salvamento automático do jogo!
